Package com.example.lotterize.ui.profile

Class AccountFragment

Fragment
com.example.lotterize.ui.profile.AccountFragment
public class AccountFragment extends Fragment
Fragment that allows users to view and edit their account information such as name, email, and phone number. When the user taps on a field, a dialog appears allowing them to update that specific detail. The updated values are reflected both on-screen and in the ProfileViewModel to maintain data consistency.
